Name: Configurable Luck
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[size=4][center][b][img]https://imgur.com/ZIUiYk2.png[/img]﻿
[/b][size=2][i]by Sophie[/i][/size][size=3][b][/b][/size][/center][size=3][b]
[/b]Allows you to set your luck value to any value between -1 and 0.74 (going higher breaks things), with a handy config option to disable the mod if you want to use the game's randomly generated luck value instead. Should make it easy to test luck-based occurrences, or maybe just do a challenge playthrough of some sort. Note that vanilla luck only extends from -0.12 to 0.12 - I'm not responsible for whatever weird things happen when you set it outside that range ;)[/size]
[b]
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/IZseuwt.png[/img]
[/size]
[/b][size=3][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][/size][/size][size=4][b]
[img]https://imgur.com/zz7AGKO.png[/img]
[size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3][list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. Linux/Mac have not been tested, but[/size][size=3] should work. Please report any issues you encounter.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player and multiplayer.[/size]
[/list][/size][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][img]https://imgur.com/BcjQX5Q.png[/img]
